searches.reason: Develop behavioral intervention probes that distinguish recent, repeated interests from incidental history. Measure ranking changes after masking recent events, removing repeated-interest evidence, or shuffling order, using matched random perturbations as controls. Connect failures to sequence encoding, temporal weighting, and training objectives; validate whether probe changes predict category-specific validation HR@10 improvements without claiming causal user preferences.

searches.reason: Build evidence-grounded challenge sets around users’ reported failures: broad relatedness outranking a precise match, unsupported prerequisites, and redundant purchases. Use only training histories and available titles/descriptions, with explicit unknown labels when compatibility or satisfied demand cannot be established. Research lightweight text methods requiring no pretrained downloads, and map reliable failure slices to hard-negative sampling or ranking-loss changes.
searches.query: recommendation diagnostic challenge sets semantic hard negatives complement substitute compatibility prerequisites redundant recommendations intent relevance evidence abstention TF-IDF 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics are trustworthy across sampled evaluation and full-catalog recommendations. Investigate rank-based alternatives to scale-sensitive margins, negative-sampling sensitivity, and uncertainty estimates for five feedback users per category. Keep immediate-choice, plausible-later, explicit rejection, and unassessable feedback separate; test diagnostic usefulness through controlled ablations while retaining the pinned macro validation HR@10 selection criterion.
